## Change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behavior, and any public API changes.

## Evidence

- [ ] `sbt verify` passes; tests cover the changed behavior and cancellation/failure boundaries.
- [ ] Independent FP/ZIO review completed; final approval, scope, reviewer identities, and reviewed revision are recorded in affected READMEs.
- [ ] Independent invariant/security review completed; all findings are resolved; scope and contracts are explicit.
- [ ] Affected README/API/architecture/tracker/test mappings are current.
- [ ] Comments, documentation, identifiers, and commit/PR text are English.
- [ ] Upstream coverage claims have scenario mappings; pending and inapplicable cases are stated.
- [ ] Resource scopes, typed failures, total access, and constructor/codec effect boundaries were reviewed manually.

- [ ] Each affected working directory has an up-to-date README.md.
- [ ] Reviewers explicitly approved the final changes after all corrections.
- [ ] Resolved temporary review reports are removed and incoming links are repaired.
- [ ] Planned or unreviewed work is not marked accepted.
- [ ] Tracker checkboxes reflect verified completion and identify the next pending task.
